note: Hand-written benchmark. Each group = tickets describing ONE underlying problem in different words. 'unrelated' = tickets that belong to no group. Add your own examples and wordings so the benchmark is not tailored to the model.

I get an invalid token error every time I try to log in with my company account.
The sign in page just spins forever for all of our users after entering credentials.
Customer card payments are failing at checkout since noon, every attempt is declined.
Our payment page shows a server error when customers try to pay for their orders.
Transactions are not going through and people cannot complete their purchases.
Checkout is rejecting every credit card we try, this started a few hours ago.
Password reset emails never arrive for any of our users.
